name: Wildemoore Farm (Jacob & Jayne Wildemore)
description: Wildemoore Farm (Jacob & Jayne Wildemore) grows Blueberries and Raspberries in Chalfont, PA. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
